Identification is exact on 1881-1966 for Wilkinson across the person file, the article and Wikidata, and the article independently carries the Ipswich Dramatic Society fabrication and the never-met that put him on this map.
summary: Frances Gregg married Louis Wilkinson in April 1912. The article is blunt about the shape of it: John Cowper Powys was deeply in love with her but, being married and unwilling to divorce, could not pursue her himself, so she married Wilkinson instead, 'causing Powys much long-term jealousy'. They had two children and divorced in 1923. She died in an air raid on Plymouth in April 1941.

sources.quote: Powys was deeply in love with Gregg, but being married and unwilling to divorce, could not himself pursue matters with her. Instead, in April 1912 Gregg married Wilkinson, causing Powys much long-term jealousy.
